messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "this list is not complete"
set: ["this list is not complete", "list is not complete", "interaction list is not complete", "this is not a complete list of side effects", "this list is not complete and many other drugs may interact", "this is not a complete list of side effects and others may occur", "not a complete list of side effects", "check product label for complete list of ingredients", "list of ingredients in this medicine", "this is not what most people pay", "is only part of complete treatment program", "Pepcid Complete", "complete treatment program", "starting is not recommended", "this is normal and will not make the medicine less effective", "this increase is needed if additional glycemic control is required"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
